items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: We had an hour, a half hour, an hour dinner session and Earl says, go get a violin someplace, you're going to have to play violin in there.

ctx.x: That's when Earl was starting to learn how to read and they were playing some overture and he went to...

I was playing fiddle up there. We had to make a concert up there. We had an hour, a half hour, an hour dinner session and Earl says, go get a violin someplace, you're going to have to play violin in there. So we played a few tunes over there and they had time for a cymbal beat and I told Earl, I said, just hold your hand in there, I'll tell you when it comes and I'll hold on in it. And when I told him now, he pulls it and there's an electric fan up there and he gets a hand hooked in the fan and down comes the…

items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: He was playing drums with us, yeah. When Crum would take off a night now and then, Godfrey would play for us.

ctx.x: You know which club he's talking about, Dick? Curly's?

Curly's. Curly's Corner. He, uh, whatever. He, uh, he went in there and the first night we were in there, but you know how loud Jumbo blew. He told Jumbo, he says, for Christ's sake you're playing so loud I can't even think. So, uh, Jumbo says, Sarah, he says, I got a contract with this guy. He says, you gotta pay me. He says, he can't find me. He says, after all I quit WWL and everything else. So, here comes two ladies down in the bar over there and some guy's wife, I don't know who it was, D'Antoni went over…
